text.title: Test Fixtures Decision Tree
text.summary: Decides between inline literal, factory function and full fixture from what the setup block does, then picks the fixture discipline the resource needs. Every conclusion references a rule id from 01-core-rules.xml.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the same setup shape (User, Order, Product, ...) appear at three or more sites, or does one test file's setup exceed roughly a third of its code?

conclusion.verdict: inline literal: one or two literal objects in the test are clearer than a factory; revisit at the third copy.

branch.question: Does the setup acquire something that must be released (database session, temp file, server process, monkeypatched attribute)?
Do tests assert on, sort by or snapshot any of the generated fields?

conclusion.verdict: factory function with keyword-only overrides and sequenced values for every asserted field; no unseeded faker.
factory function with keyword-only parameters and explicit defaults; faker acceptable for unasserted fields.

branch.question: Is the resource a database session or transaction?

conclusion.verdict: function-scoped session fixture inside a transaction or savepoint rolled back after yield; engine may be session-scoped.
function-scoped yield fixture with idempotent teardown after yield; widen scope only after a durations profile.
every session-scoped fixture is per-worker: name resources with worker_id or guard with a file lock.
